chapters.reason: The paper focuses on distilling System 2 reasoning (like Chain-of-Thought) into System 1, which aligns with semantic anchoring by compressing explicit reasoning traces into implicit representations to ensure semantic fidelity.
The distillation process involves iterative refinement of the model's internal reasoning capabilities, matching progressive refinement through step-by-step internalization of reasoning patterns.
The approach distills reasoning into the model's internal states (System 1) without explicit tokens, corresponding to internal_state_level regulation of reasoning via hidden states.
